description: Implementation of BufferGL class methods for OpenGL buffer management in ANGLE project, including buffer data operations, mapping, copying, and index range retrieval.

classes.name: BufferGL
classes.description: A class managing OpenGL buffer objects with support for data operations, mapping, copying, and index range queries.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data of the buffer, optionally updating a shadow copy.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of the buffer data.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Copies a subset of data from another buffer.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the entire buffer for access.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a specific range of the buffer for access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the buffer, optionally updating shadow data.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Computes the index range of elements in the buffer.

methods.name: getBufferID
methods.description: Returns the OpenGL buffer object ID.
